notes.text: The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 7 games cover only 29% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the third-lowest in the league (a typical team: 45%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Darnell Nurse is day to day and missed their last game. He is a top-pair defenseman. Dmitry Orlov has taken his spot beside Michael Kesselring.
Ivan Demidov is on injured reserve (lower-body injury) and has missed the last 5 games. He is one of their most valuable skaters.
Mike Matheson is out (lower-body injury) and has missed the last 2 games. He is a top-pair defenseman. Lane Hutson has taken his spot beside Noah Dobson.
Oliver Kapanen has not played this season.
Owen Beck was added to the roster on Oct 14 and has played beside Jake Evans and Kirby Dach.
Arber Xhekaj has started killing penalties: on the ice for 30% of the team’s shorthanded time in 7 games, up from 6% last season.

MTL.head: The matchup suits the Canadiens
MTL.body: Even though Montréal will be without Demidov, the Canadiens have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and have home-ice advantage. The Sharks’ way back in is getting good looks.

SJS.head: The Sharks face a real test
